site.title: Rivet Safety, protective equipment and safety training for manufacturers
site.description: PPE supply and on-site safety training for manufacturers with 50 to 500 employees in Ohio, Pennsylvania and Michigan.
site.markdown:
# Safety gear and training for the plant floor

Rivet supplies gloves, eye protection, hearing protection and fall gear on a monthly schedule, and runs OSHA training on site.

## Who we serve

Manufacturers with 50 to 500 employees in Ohio, Pennsylvania and Michigan: metal fabrication, plastics, food processing and packaging plants.

## Training

Forklift, lockout tagout, hazard communication and confined space, delivered at your plant by our trainers.

## Work with us

We partner with insurance brokers, staffing firms and equipment dealers that serve the same plants.
